title: salix purpurea var. angustifolia
intro: Salix purpurea var. angustifolia, commonly known as narrow-leaved purple willow or salix, is a variety of the salix purpurea plant that belongs to the willow family (Salicaceae). It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including reducing fever, alleviating rheumatic pain, and treating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Salix purpurea var. angustifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicylic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
